英文第41題｜吃播流行的原因

英文 / 綜合 / 綜合 · 首次出題日期：2026-09-08

分享原卷｜第 41 題

完整原題

作答所需文章／材料

Mukbang: Why Do People Watch Others Eat? Mukbang is a new kind of online show. In these videos, people eat a lot of food while talking to their viewers. Many fans sit in front of a computer and watch them eat. In most countries, eating is a time for family and friends to get together and have some fun. People share food, stories, and joy. But some people eat alone and feel lonely. In South Korea, many people live alone, but eating alone is still not a common habit. Because of this, Mukbang becomes very popular. Mukbang started in 2010 on a Korean website, AfreecaTV. The word “Mukbang”（먹방）comes from two Korean words: 먹（meok, meaning “eat”）and 방송（bangsong, meaning “broadcast”）. It means eating on live videos. Watching someone eat and talk makes people feel like they are eating together, even if they are alone. Some people worry that Mukbang can make viewers eat too much. In South Korea, the number of overweight people grew from 26% in 1998 to 35% in 2016. In 2018, Korea made rules to help people eat healthier and watch Mukbang safely. However, some people still think the number may grow more by 2030. Even with these worries, thousands of people watch their favorite Mukbang programs every day. Many enjoy the food, the talk and the feeling of not being alone. 字詞：viewer 觀眾；website 網站；broadcast 廣播；overweight 肥胖的；feeling 感覺。
Why does Mukbang become popular in South Korea? (A) People want to eat more food. (B) People can make money by watching. (C) People don’t like to eat by themselves. (D) It is cheaper than eating at a restaurant.
先想一想，再查看答案、解說與原圖
原卷作答：C
正確答案：C。第一段說有人獨食會孤單，第二段說看吃播有一起用餐的感覺，符合此選項。

逐項解析

選項與原句判讀句意與判斷理由
(A)
People want to eat more food.		不選

吃很多是影片中的現象，但文章解釋流行原因時強調孤單與陪伴，不是想多吃。

(B)
People can make money by watching.		不選

文章未說觀看者可因觀看賺錢，不要把觀眾與主播的角色混淆。

(C)
People don’t like to eat by themselves.		應選

第一段說有人獨食會孤單，第二段說看吃播有一起用餐的感覺，符合此選項。

(D)
It is cheaper than eating at a restaurant.		不選

文章沒有比較吃播與餐廳的花費。

詳細說明與解題步驟

題目問「為什麼流行」，找第一段的feel lonely與Because of this，再配合第二段feel like they are eating together。by themselves＝alone，指自己一個人，答案C。
文章大意：吃播讓獨自用餐的人有陪伴感，觀眾喜歡食物、談話與不孤單的感覺；另一方面，有人擔心它使人吃得過多。文中同時呈現吸引力與疑慮。這是依原題文章作閱讀理解，不將文中的人口比例或規定當成現況資料，也不能僅憑兩個年代的比例就證明吃播造成肥胖。

① Why問原因，先找lonely

第一段說，有些人eat alone而feel lonely，接著以Because of this說明吃播流行。這個因果線索，比看到影片裡很多食物更重要。

② 螢幕帶來一起用餐的感覺

第二段說，看人吃東西、聽人聊天，會feel like they are eating together。這是陪伴感，觀眾實際上仍可能獨自在家，不是主播到他家吃飯。

③ by themselves，就是自己一個人

C的eat by themselves對應文中的eat alone。因為不喜歡獨食的孤單而尋求陪伴，符合本文原因；文中沒有說觀眾靠觀看賺錢，也未比較餐廳花費。

④ 找流行原因：獨食的孤單與線上陪伴

答案 C：不喜歡自己一個人用餐

  • 原因線索：feel lonely → Because of this。
  • by themselves＝alone；陪伴感解釋流行。
  • 後段對過量進食的疑慮，不能取代題目所問的流行原因。
